title: How We Assess: Alternative Assessment
abstract: The topic for the AIChE Education Division's Spring Survey in 2025 is alternative assessment. We will present results from this survey of chemical engineering faculty teaching in the US and Canada on their use of different forms of alternative assessment to provide an overview of the use of this approach in chemical engineering instruction.

title: How We Teach: Process Control
abstract: The topic for the AIChE Education Division's Course Survey in Fall 2025 is process control. We will present results from this survey of faculty teaching the course in the US and Canada. Information will include textbooks used, topics covered, assessments, labs, and simulations.

title: Process Control Panel Discussion
abstract: The AIChE Education Division will survey both industry and faculty about process control courses during 2025. During this time, we will discuss the results and the future of teaching process control with experience process control faculty.
